stem: An early node-associated reproductive structure is too undeveloped for confident classification. What should the observer do?
choices: Map and describe the structure, record uncertainty, and repeat the observation as development continues
Assign a permanent classification from the cultivar name
Assume a feminized seed cannot produce an unexpected structure
Remove the structure solely because it is uncertain
rationale: Early reproductive morphology can be ambiguous. Documenting location and uncertainty and repeating the observation is stronger than forcing a classification without sufficient evidence.
